title: Pre-ServiceTeachers’ Experiences in Blending Technology Tools to Create EFL Learning Videos
descriptions: This study explored the experiences of PSTs in blending various technology tools to develop/create English as a Foreign Language (EFL) learning materials through the process of technology tools selection, blend process, and video accomplishment in a technology classroom. The experiences also brought out the problems faced by PSTs’ during the teaching and learning process.
